# Resin

Type: Material | Internal ID: Resin | Source: Birch Trees, Beech Trees, Fir Trees, Pine Trees, Oak Trees, Yggdrasil shoots, Greyling, Greydwarf, Greydwarf shaman, Greydwarf brute, Kvastur, Chest in Meadows, Barrel next to Greydwarf building spawns in Black Forest | Usage: Building, Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Resin is dropped by Greyling, Greydwarf, Greydwarf shaman, Greydwarf brute, and Kvastur. It has a chance of dropping from all trees except for Ancient Trees and Scorched Trees, and can be occasionally found in Chest in the Meadows.

Categorias: Materials
